description: This file contains CSS declarations for theming and styling the App component in a React application. It defines CSS variables for light and dark themes and contains styles for various classes used in the application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main container for the application, applies background and text color based on the current theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styles applied to the application logo, defines size and optional animation.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles applied to the header of the application, centers content and applies themed background.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for links used within the application, applies themed colors.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the button that toggles the theme between light and dark modes.
